segments.text: As kids, many of us wanted to be an astronaut. Now, ISRO is making sure those dreams actually come true. First,
follow full disclosure and let me show you what's happening. ISRO launched UIA 2026 young scientist program designed to
introduce class 9 students to space science technology and applications. The program runs from May 11th to May 22nd, 2026. [music]
two weeks fully residential at major ISRO centers including Vikram Sarabhai Space Center, Satish Dhawan Space Center
and URAO satellite center. Students attend expert lectures, facility visits,
hands-on demonstrations and interact with ISRO scientists working on India space missions. [music]
Eligibility is straightforward. You must be studying in class 9th as of January 1st, 2026 in any school within India. It
will give you two weeks inside ISRO facilities getting to watch how satellites are built, how missions are planned and how India space technology
actually works. Applications open February 27, 2026 and deadline is March 31st, 2026.
